_about: Story structures for reels. Every reel uses exactly one, and the agent does not repeat any of the last three used. Each has the same outer shape: a hook that lands in the first 2 seconds, the body, a payoff, and a last line that loops back into the first frame. Target 25 to 35 seconds (65 to 95 spoken words): Instagram favours 7 to 30 second reels for reach to non-followers, and completion and replays are its strongest signal. goal says which action the reel is built to earn: send (a DM to a friend: funny, surprising, relatable) or save (useful, step by step).

formats.name: Open loop (curiosity gap)
beats: hook: a strange result or a question the viewer can't answer yet
clue 1: a small reveal that raises the stakes
clue 2: a second reveal that nearly answers it
payoff: the answer, shown not told
loop: a last line that sends the viewer back to the opening image
formats.when: a surprising true finding, a weird bug, a counter-intuitive result
formats.visual: hold back the key image until the payoff; show the mystery object early and let the camera circle it

formats.name: Problem, agitate, solve
beats: hook: name the exact problem the viewer has, in their words
agitate: show what it quietly costs them (make the cost visible)
solve: the fix in 2 or 3 concrete moves
payoff: the after state
loop
formats.when: a common, painful SEO or content problem with a clear fix
formats.visual: make the cost physical: a leaking bucket of clicks, a page sinking, a chart sliding

formats.name: Before, after, bridge
beats: hook: the after state first, the result that makes them stop
before: where it started
bridge: the one change that got there
payoff: the result again, now understood
loop
formats.when: a transformation with a clear cause; only real numbers from our own data, or a clearly labelled example
formats.visual: split screen or a wipe between before and after; the bridge is one visible action

formats.name: Myth bust
beats: hook: state the myth as if it were true, with confidence
the twist: why people believe it
the bust: show it failing (smash, cross out, stamp)
the truth: what actually works
loop
formats.when: a popular SEO belief that is wrong or outdated
formats.visual: the myth is an object that gets physically broken; the truth replaces it

formats.name: Start in the middle
beats: hook: drop straight into the disaster at its worst moment
rewind: '3 weeks earlier' and the innocent-looking cause
escalation: how it got worse
payoff: the fix or the lesson
loop: end on the same moment as the opening, now defused
formats.when: a story with a dramatic moment: a traffic crash, a deindexed page, a broken launch
formats.visual: freeze-frame the opening, whip-pan for the rewind, match-cut back at the end

formats.name: Reveal ladder
beats: hook: the first surprising thing
reveal 2: something bigger
reveal 3: the biggest, the one they'll repeat
payoff: what it means for them
loop
formats.when: several facts that build on each other, each more surprising
formats.visual: each rung zooms out to reveal a bigger picture (camera pull-out ladder)

formats.name: Beginner vs pro
beats: hook: most people do X
the beginner move, shown going wrong
the pro move, shown working
payoff: the one difference
loop
formats.when: a task done two ways, one clearly better
formats.visual: two characters side by side doing the same task; split screen with a divider

formats.name: Ticking clock
beats: hook: something is running out (time, clicks, a window)
what happens when it runs out
the steps to beat the clock, fast
payoff: saved just in time
loop
formats.when: a real deadline or decay: content decay, a migration, a Google update rolling out
formats.visual: a clock or countdown on screen the whole time; pace speeds up

formats.name: Stacked micro-payoffs (countdown)
beats: hook: '3 signs your blog post is dying' style promise
sign 3
sign 2
sign 1, the best one
loop
formats.when: a list of 3 checks, signs or mistakes; each item is its own tiny payoff every 6 to 8 seconds
formats.visual: a big number per item; each item gets its own mini scene

formats.name: What if (thought experiment)
beats: hook: an absurd what-if (what if Google deleted page 2?)
play it out: the funny chaos
the real lesson hiding in it
payoff: what to actually do
loop
formats.when: to make a dry fact memorable through exaggeration
formats.visual: comic exaggeration: things falling, characters panicking, cartoon physics

formats.name: POV skit
beats: hook: 'POV: you are a blog post from 2019'
the character's day going wrong in a relatable way
the turn: someone finally fixes it
payoff: the character thriving
loop
formats.when: turning an SEO idea into a character with feelings; the most shareable format
formats.visual: the thing (a page, a crawler, a keyword) is a character with a face; first-person framing

formats.name: Explain it with one metaphor
beats: hook: a technical term people pretend to understand
the metaphor: one everyday picture that maps to it
how the pieces map, shown in the metaphor
payoff: the term, now obvious, and why it matters
loop
formats.when: a concept: crawling, indexing, canonical tags, cannibalization, AI overviews
formats.visual: stay inside one metaphor world for the whole reel (a library, a restaurant, a city)
